items.title: Ingrid Sertso interviewed by Monk Rowe, Woodstock, New York, August 11, 2014
items.q: She’s the one that sang “You Ain’t Nothing But a Hound Dog?”

ctx.x: I mean that’s — it’s much more authentic than Elvis, by a long shot. I mean she was a blues shouter.
She’s the one that sang “You Ain’t Nothing But a Hound Dog?”
Yes. And then Elvis covered it. You know. Plus it was written by two young white men, so that the way this music finds its way in and out to these people is very interesting.
